sentences.text: DAVID: GOOD NEWS IS GOOD NEWS, AND THIS IS VERY GOOD NEWS.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: LAUREN, THANK YOU.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: JOINING ME NOW IS LIZ PEEK, FOX NEWS CONTRIBUTOR, AND JASON KATZ, UBS MANAGING DIRECTOR.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: GOOD TO SEE YOU BOTH.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: THANKS FOR BEING HERE.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: YOU KNOW, JASON, LAST WEEK I HAD KEN FISHER ON, AND HE WAS VERY OPTIMISTIC.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: I MEAN, HE DOES THESE HISTORIC ANALYSES OF INVESTMENT CYCLES AND SEES THAT IN A PERIOD SUCH AS THIS WHERE YOU HAVE A PRESIDENT FROM ONE PARTY AND A CONGRESS HELD BY ANOTHER PARTY, IT'S ALWAYS GOOD COMING OUT OF A MIDTERMS LIKE WE HAVE.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: IS THAT OPTIMISM, IS THAT WHAT PLAYED OUT TODAY?
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: >> I THINK -- WELL, FIRST OF ALL, I WILL TELL YOU THE LAST FEW TRADING DAYS COULD BE THE WILDEST OF MY THREE DECADES ON WALL STREET, BUT I DIGRESS.
TODAY, DAVID, WAS MUCH MORE ABOUT OIL, TRUMP'S TO CONCILIATORY TONE AND THE PARADE OF GOOD EARNINGS.
SO THE ECONOMIC CONDITIONS ARE VERY SUPPORTIVE OF EQUITIES IN SPITE OF WHAT HAPPENED IN TERMS OF THE MIDTERMS.
DAVID: AND, LIZ, YOU KNOW, I'M JUST WONDERING IF THE DEMOCRATS -- AND THERE'S A THEME HERE.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: WE'RE GOING TO GET BACK TO IT WITH OTHER GUESTS.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: BUT WHETHER THE DEMOCRATS ARE OVERPLAYING THEIR HAND.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: YOU HAVE BERNIE SANDERS COMING OUT, AND HE'S PRACTICALLY GLOWING AS A RESULT OF THE MIDTERM ELECTIONS.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: AND NOW HE WANTS TO EXPAND IT'S NOT JUST MEDICARE FOR ALL, NOW HE WANTS TO EXPAND SOCIAL SECURITY.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: [LAUGHTER] A LOT OF PEOPLE QUESTION WHETHER THOSE PATHETIC 1 AND 2% GAINS YOU MAKE ON SOCIAL SECURITY WHEN YOU CAN MAKE FOUR TIMES THAT BY JUST INVESTING IN THE MARKET IS REALLY WORTH IT.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: WELL, HE WANTS TO GIVE MORE MONEY TO THE GOVERNMENT BECAUSE HE THINKS IT'S DOING SO WELL.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: [LAUGHTER] >> I DON'T THINK THAT'S ANY SURPRISE, DAVID.
sentences.speaker: DAVID

sentences.text: I THINK WHAT WE'RE SEEING IS A BIT OF A RECKONING JUST HOW FAR CAN DEMOCRATS GO IN TERMS OF SLOWING A.I., SLOWING THE BUILDOUT OF A.I., DATA CENTERS AND SO FORTH.
I THINK THAT'S THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL ISSUE FACING VOTERS AND ALSO VOTING -- INVESTORS RIGHT NOW AS THEY ROOK AT WHAT HAPPENED IN THE MIDTERMS.

IN OTHER WORDS, TODAY OR YESTERDAY THE TEXAS GOVERNOR, THE NEWLY-ELECTED TEXAS GOVERNOR, GINA HINOJOSA, SAID, WELL, WE'RE NOT GOING TO BLOCK OR PERMANENTLY BAN DATA CENTERS FROM CONSTRUCTION, INSTEAD WE WANT SOME SENSIBLE REGULATION.
LOOK, THAT'S GOING TO HAPPEN ACROSS THE COUNTRY.
YOU'RE NOT GOING TO STOP THIS THING.
SPENDING ON A.
A.I. DATA CENTERS IN SEPTEMBER WAS UP 90% YEAR-OVER-YEAR.
THIS THING IS ROLLING, AND IT'S NOT GOING TO STOP JUST BECAUSE WE'VE HAD A CHANGE IN THE POLITICAL LEADERSHIP.

AND I DO THINK, YOU KNOW, WHEN YOU HAVE ELIZABETH WARREN TAKING OVER AN IMPORTANT SENATE COMMITTEE, THE BANKING COMMITTEE, AND WHEN BERNIE SANDERS IS GOING TO RUN THE COMMITTEE THAT OVERSEES SOCIAL SECURITY AND STUFF, I THINK THERE'S PLENTY OF CAUSE FOR ALARM.
